title: You sing His name… but does your life echo His voice?
paragraphs: You sing His name… but does your life echo His voice?

Not everyone who says “Lord” is aligned with Him.
That’s not my opinion—that’s the warning of Jesus Himself.
And this… this is where it gets uncomfortable.
🔥 6 QUESTIONS TO TEST YOUR ALIGNMENT WITH JESUS
1. Do I obey Jesus… or just admire Him?
“If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.” — John 14:15

Admiration is easy.
Obedience costs.

2. Do I repent quickly—or defend my sin?
When conviction comes, do you soften…
or argue?

Grace is free.
But it never excuses rebellion.

3. Is my private life pure… or just my public image?
God sees what no one else scrolls.
What no one else hears.
What no one else knows.

Holiness isn’t performance.
It’s integrity in the dark.

4. Do I hunger for God’s Word… or just content about Him?
There’s a difference between
being inspired
and being transformed.

One feeds emotion.
The other renews your mind.

5. Am I becoming more like Jesus—or just more religious?
More posts.
More quotes.
More “Christian” language.

But is there more patience?
More humility?
More love?

6. If everything was stripped away… would I still follow Him?
No platform.
No applause.
No comfort.
Just a cross.
Would you still say yes?
But here’s what we miss…

This is not a checklist to earn God’s love.
You already failed that test.
This is a mirror.

And when you see the cracks—
don’t run.
Run to Jesus.

Because alignment doesn’t start with perfection.
It starts with surrender.

At the cross, your disobedience met His mercy.
Your sin met His blood.
Your failure met His finished work.
And He didn’t turn away.
So today—realign.

Not by trying harder.
But by bowing lower.

Repent.
Return.
Receive grace again.
